fonasa.limitation: No current official newsroom capture from the runner or secondary navigation. No unverified fallback enabled.

fonasa_datos_abiertos.limitation: PDF/spreadsheet/title periods never become publication dates. Independent paths blocked; schema not assumed.

isp_anamed.limitation: Indexed official table corroborates labels and publication column; it is not live raw HTML or PDF capture.

isp_surveillance.limitation: Date/week in report title or filename is excluded. Respiratory detail date must be bound to its exact PDF link.

deis.limitation: Secondary browser can read Centro FIC notices and two PDFs; runner captures remain blocked. Data period, upload directory, month-only and editorial-only updates remain excluded.

source_health_integrity.scope_metadata: Web preserves unrelated historic source rows and overall generated_at; public_data_sources_checked_at identifies this limited refresh.
source_health_integrity.orchestrator_queue_change: Only the task source_repair_public_data_lane_2026_10_11 plus file updated_at is changed; status, evidence, blocker and resume action belong to this authorized lane.

resolved_review_findings.issue: List diagnostics could raise AttributeError in engine/source_health.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Normalized source diagnostics to dictionaries; production imports and replay tests pass.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Publication guard accepted unrelated official detail URLs and arbitrary date substrings.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Strict whole-field date parsing, detail identity binding and listing provenance binding; independent adversarial repros now return False.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Generic HTML/PDF helpers followed redirects without official final-authority validation.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Scoped HTTPS allowlist checks before redirects and after response, default proxy/CA preserved, PDF signature/content validation.

resolved_review_findings.issue: ANAMED/laboratory row date was not bound to publication column semantics.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Recognized Fecha Publicacion column binding, colspan handling and changed-header regression rejection.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Historic signals or undated candidates could mask current coverage gap.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Zero verified-publication diagnostics affect health even with historic signal; partial fronts produce degraded/partial health.

resolved_review_findings.issue: PDF capture failure was indistinguishable from AI budget deferral.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Scoped engine records exact deferred reasons/causes and capture_pending diagnostics; unrelated lanes retain original behavior.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Detail-to-PDF date exception required coherent document link evidence.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Guard requires matching detail, document and explicit link evidence identities.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Monitor could claim operational after dated listing without downloading PDFs.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Monitor verifies every discovered PDF, stores SHA256/final URL/byte count/capture timestamp, and marks failed PDF captures degraded/nonoperational.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Legacy tests could pass via early guard/transport failure instead of exercising AI assessment.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Updated explicit evidence fixtures and actual scoped-helper patches; stage-specific deferral assertions pass.

improvement_review.maintainability: Per-source modules plus shared scoped transport/provenance avoid changing unrelated source fetch behavior. Daily engine directly imports strict scouts; legacy DEIS hub scout remains compatibility code and should be clearly deprecated in a future cleanup.
improvement_review.integrity: Synthetic fixtures are labeled; indexed/rendered browser evidence is distinguished from wire captures and origin status. No false LIVE/operational evidence enters publication state.
improvement_review.scope_clarity: Implementation, health refresh, audit artifacts and task ledger stay within the five authorized lanes. The pre-existing normative snapshot failure is explicit and unchanged.

required_external_resume: Enable only required official authorities through the supported environment network configuration; preserve proxy and verified TLS.
Run PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python scripts/check_public_sources.py --record-health and retain current raw official HTML/PDF captures, headers/final URLs and date evidence.
Replay real captures through the parsers, rerun source regressions and Reviewer; do not treat synthetic fixture success or browser indexing as runner operational validation.
